NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 18, 12:20 AM ET

Bijan Robinson is the top-projected running back on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 25.7 DraftKings points for $8,700, against Chicago. Kenneth Walker III (25.0, $8,500) and Kyren Williams (21.5, $6,800) are next.

Kyren Williams returns the most per dollar among running backs projected for at least 9 points: 3.17 projected points per $1,000 at $6,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 18, 12:20 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 6

Bijan Robinson, ATL vs CHI ($8,700)

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 25.7 DraftKings points at $8,700, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.7 points clear of Kenneth Walker III. The model gives him 17.5 carries and 5.0 targets. The salary works out to 2.95 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 19 at the position. Across 25,000 simulations Robinson averaged 25.6 points with a simulated floor of 13.3 and a ceiling of 41.7, and he holds 28% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 1.5-point underdog at home against Chicago, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 52.5.

Kenneth Walker III, KC vs LAC ($8,500)

Kenneth Walker III projects 2nd at the position with 25.0 DraftKings points at $8,500, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 5.0 targets. The salary works out to 2.94 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 19 at the position. Across 25,000 simulations Walker averaged 25.0 points with a simulated floor of 13.0 and a ceiling of 41.0, and he holds 20% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 7.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 24.5 in a game totaled at 41.5.

Kyren Williams, LAR vs ARI ($6,800)

Kyren Williams projects 3rd at the position with 21.5 DraftKings points at $6,800, 5th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 17.6 carries and 4.4 targets. The salary works out to 3.17 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 19 at the position. Across 25,000 simulations Williams averaged 21.6 points with a simulated floor of 10.1 and a ceiling of 38.4, and he holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 12.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 32 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Braelon Allen, NYJ at NE ($5,700)

Braelon Allen projects for 16.0 DraftKings points at $5,700, which works out to 2.81 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 19 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 18.5 carries and 2.6 targets. Across 25,000 simulations Allen averaged 16.0 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 30.3, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Jets are a 7.5-point underdog on the road against New England, with an implied team total of 18 in a game totaled at 43.5.
